newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Volga-Dnepr boosts sales volume Jan-Aug'96.
newsitem.headline: Russian Volga-Dnepr boosts sales volume Jan-Aug'96.

text.p: Russian private cargo airline Volga-Dnepr had sales of $63.5 million during the first eight months of this year compared with $42.3 million in the same period of 1995, a company spokesman said on Monday.

Konstantin Rogov told Reuters by telephone from the central Russian city of Ulyanovsk that operations with Antonov An-124-100 heavy cargo aircraft accounted for $59 million of the company's sales between January and August, which was 53 percent more than in the same period of last year.
An-124-100s carried 21,920 tonnes of cargo out of the company's total 23,754 tonnes.
Ulyanovsk-based Volga-Dnepr operates 14 cargo planes -- six An-124s, five Il-76s, two An-12s and one An-32. It had sales of $87.2 million in 1995 compared with $87.8 million in 1994.
